name: Acolyte
description: You have spent your life in the service of a temple to a specific god or pantheon of gods. You act as an intermediary between the realm of the holy and the mortal world, performing sacred rites and offering sacrifices in order to conduct worshipers into the presence of the divine. You are not necessarily a cleric – performing sacred rites is not the same thing as channeling divine power.

0.description: A holy symbol (a gift to you when you entered the priesthood)
A prayer book or prayer wheel

features.name: Acolyte Proficiencies
features.description: You have proficiency with the following skills: Insight and Religion. You also know two languages of your choice.

features.name: Commandments of Faith
features.description: As an acolyte, you have several sayings or values that were instilled in you. Record three of these that you hold onto most. Once per session, when you fully embody one of these principles, you may recover 2 Stress Slots.

features.name: Origin Feat
features.description: You have a feat that was gained through your background. Choose one of the following Origin Feats
